property_summary: For any caller and any locked-in guess/block, the correct contract never pays out when blockhash for the guess block is zero; the mutant inverts the check and may pay out when blockhash==0 (so its balance or payout behavior can differ).
change_summary: Replace the comparison that checks answer != 0 with equality check answer == 0, inverting the guard so payout happens only when blockhash is zero.
